Sample Dispatch Form (Chain of Custody) 18 checkpoints across 6 sections.Every time samples are dispatched from site to external lab or inter-lab transfer Download ExcelDownload PDF **18** Checkpoints **6** Sections Per dispatch event Site QC Engineer, Lab Technician [ISO/IEC 17025:2017](https://infralens.in/code/IS-17025-2017) [IS 4031:1988](https://infralens.in/code/IS-4031-Part-3-1988) [IS 516:1959](https://infralens.in/code/IS-516-Part-2-1959) Related [📐ISO/IEC 17025](https://infralens.in/code/ISO/IEC-17025) [✏️Cube Acceptance Criteria M25](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/cube-acceptance-criteria-m25) [📘Concrete Mix Ratios](https://infralens.in/handbook/concrete-mix-ratios) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧rcc-design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A.
